desc: Derive a fast transition for long free runs from the \(B\)-bit state without iterating up to \(N\) or \(2^B\) per interval.
Design the transition across each bad interval, ensuring forbidden positions remain unreachable and endpoints are handled correctly.
Prove correctness and establish \(O(M\,\mathrm{poly}(B))\) time and \(O(B)\) memory.
Implement the algorithm in Python with 64-bit-safe arithmetic and exact `Yes`/`No` output.
Test edge cases including \(M=0\), \(A=B\), large gaps, short/adjacent intervals, and targets near the final obstacle.
